purpose: A bare centred h1 head, with the page's intro paragraph as a separate following block.
maxWordsBasis: word-counted from the four real headings and the four real intro paragraphs
geometry: block y 45, h 206.13; h1 one line on all four routes; intro max-w-[59ch] or max-w-[60ch]

responsive.max-wf-tablet: two-column rows stack; the 108em hero frame narrows to 80em
responsive.max-wf-phone: flex rows become flex-col and centre; the hero frame becomes w-full
responsive.max-wf-mini: block margins drop from 4.2em to 3.5em; display headings drop a step; hero top padding rises to 11.8em
responsive.note: All three are MAX-width queries. The em engine is frozen at 8.25833px below 992px, so 768 and 390 differ only by these class overrides.

containerVariants.T-CASE-STUDY-INDEX: standard wrapper: mx-auto -mt-[3em] w-full max-w-[1920px] px-[6em] max-wf-tablet:px-[6vw]
containerVariants.T-SCHEDULER: standard wrapper: mx-auto -mt-[3em] w-full max-w-[1920px] px-[6em] max-wf-tablet:px-[6vw]
containerVariants.T-CONTACT: ZERO-GUTTER wrapper: mx-auto -mt-[3em] w-full max-w-[1920px] px-0 max-wf-tablet:px-0
containerVariants.T-REFERRAL: ZERO-GUTTER wrapper: mx-auto -mt-[3em] w-full max-w-[1920px] px-0 max-wf-tablet:px-0
containerVariants.why: Leaving px-[6em] on the zero-gutter routes would make the h1 and intro 128px narrower and re-wrap them.
